companies.name: Amazon
companies.sections_zh: Work Style 评估（领导力准则情境题，约 15–20 分钟）+ Work Simulation（模拟收件箱决策题，约 50 分钟）
companies.sections_en: Work Style Assessment (Leadership Principles SJT, ~15–20 min) + Work Simulation (simulated inbox decisions, ~50 min)
companies.notes_zh: 适用 SDE 实习和新毕业生（SDE I），部分地区报告编程部分为 70 分钟。题目多为 Amazon 自编的 HackerRank 情景题，代码必须能编译运行，系统会监测粘贴。
companies.notes_en: Applies to SDE interns and new grads (SDE I); some regions report 70 min for coding. Problems are Amazon-written HackerRank scenarios; code must compile and copy-paste is monitored.

refs.title: Amazon SDE II OA prep (official, 2 questions / 90 min)
Glassdoor: Amazon graduate SDE OA report (2025)

companies.focus_zh: 考贪心排序、哈希计数、前缀和、滑动窗口和二分答案这几类套路，难点是从长篇业务故事里认出模型，并写出不超时的解法。
companies.focus_en: Greedy with sorting, hash-map counting, prefix sums, sliding windows and binary search on the answer. The hard part is spotting the pattern inside a long story and keeping it fast enough for the hidden tests.
companies.style_zh: 题面都包在仓库、服务器、包裹、运力这类 Amazon 业务故事里，篇幅长，内核是 LeetCode medium 套路。暴力解通常过不了隐藏的大数据用例。
companies.style_en: Every problem is wrapped in a long Amazon story about warehouses, servers, packages or shipping capacity, with a LeetCode-medium pattern underneath. Brute force usually times out on the large hidden tests.
companies.tips_zh: 先看数据范围，目标 O(n log n)；排序+贪心、滑动窗口、前缀和、二分答案要练到读完故事就能说出模型。Work Style 部分按领导力准则作答，前后保持一致。
companies.tips_en: Check the constraints first and aim for O(n log n). Drill sort+greedy, sliding window, prefix sums and binary search on the answer until you can name the pattern right after reading the story. In the Work Style section, answer consistently with the Leadership Principles.

companies.name: Meta
companies.sections_zh: 无（全程摄像头和麦克风监考）
companies.notes_zh: 2025 年起 E3/新毕业生多数报告为 CodeSignal Industry Coding 式：一道项目题分 4 关递进（如内存 KV 库：get/set → TTL → 版本查询 → 删除），过关才解锁下一关，本模拟用 4 道独立题近似。也有 2026 报告为 4 道独立 easy/medium、70 分钟；禁止使用 AI。
companies.notes_en: Since 2025 most E3/new-grad reports describe a CodeSignal Industry Coding style test: one project problem in 4 gated levels (e.g. in-memory KV store: get/set → TTL → versioning → deletion); simulated here as 4 independent problems. Some 2026 reports show 4 separate easy/medium problems in 70 min instead. No AI tools.

refs.title: Hello Interview: Meta E3 guide (OA section)

companies.focus_zh: 主考工程实现：一道系统题分 4 关往上加功能（比如内存 KV 库，从增删查到 TTL，再到按时间点查历史版本），算法要求不高，拼的是数据结构设计和写码速度。
companies.focus_en: Mainly implementation: one system built up over 4 levels, say an in-memory KV store going from CRUD to TTL to point-in-time version lookups. The algorithms are light; what counts is the data model and coding speed.
companies.style_zh: 每关在上一关的代码上加需求，描述长、边界情况多，哈希表加按时间排序的版本列表基本能撑到最后。也有人拿到旧版 GCA：4 道互不相关的 easy/medium（双指针、字符串、数组模拟）。
companies.style_en: Each level adds requirements on top of the previous level's code, with wordy specs and lots of edge cases; a hash map plus time-sorted version lists carries you most of the way. Some candidates still get the older GCA: four unrelated easy/medium problems (two pointers, strings, array simulation).
companies.tips_zh: 开写前先定好数据模型（key → 按时间戳排序的版本列表），后面几关只是往上扩展，不用推倒重来。每关先让测试全过再谈优化，不少人只做到第 3 关也进了下一轮。
companies.tips_en: Settle the data model before coding (key -> versions sorted by timestamp) so later levels extend it instead of forcing a rewrite. Get each level's tests passing before optimizing anything; plenty of people advance after clearing only levels 1-3.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.sections_zh: 无（偶有少量选择题或调试题）
companies.sections_en: None (occasionally a few MCQs or a debugging task)
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生最常见的是 HackerRank 两题 90 分钟，部分批次改用 Codility（两题 100–110 分钟，提交前看不到隐藏用例结果）。高频考点：字符串、贪心、滑动窗口、前缀和、DP。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new-grad OAs are most often 2 HackerRank problems in 90 min; some batches use Codility (2 problems, 100–110 min, hidden test results not shown). Common topics: strings, greedy, sliding window, prefix sums, DP.

refs.title: 1point3acres: Microsoft new grad OA (100 min, 2 questions)
Blind: what to expect for Microsoft OA new grad

companies.focus_zh: 以数组、字符串、哈希计数和贪心为主，偶尔有位运算或数学题。难度 easy~medium，但隐藏用例对正确性和性能都卡得严。
companies.focus_en: Mostly arrays, strings, hash counting and greedy, with the occasional bit or math problem. Difficulty is easy to medium, but the hidden tests are strict on both correctness and speed.
companies.style_zh: 题面短、直接，不讲故事，多是经典题改编：异位词、字符串表示的大数相乘、用栈实现队列、校验 BST 后序序列。Codility 版提交前看不到隐藏用例的结果。
companies.style_en: Short, direct statements with no story, mostly twists on classics: anagrams, multiplying numbers stored as strings, a queue built from stacks, validating a BST postorder. On Codility you don't see hidden test results before submitting.
companies.tips_zh: 提交前自己把空输入、单元素、整数溢出、超大 n 过一遍。刷 Microsoft 标签的数组、字符串、哈希题时，按 Codility 的方式计时、不看测试反馈。
companies.tips_en: Before submitting, run empty input, a single element, integer overflow and max-size n yourself. Practice Microsoft-tagged array, string and hashing problems on a timer without looking at test feedback, the way Codility runs it.

companies.name: TikTok / ByteDance
companies.sections_zh: 无（2026 起已取消选择题）
companies.notes_zh: 2026 年报告显示平台从 HackerRank 换成 CodeSignal：4 道纯编程题，70–90 分钟，前两题简单，后两题 medium 且分值更高，须开摄像头并共享屏幕。2025 版是 HackerRank：约 5 道选择题加 2–3 道编程（部分含 SQL），最长 120 分钟。
companies.notes_en: 2026 reports: moved from HackerRank to CodeSignal with 4 coding-only problems in 70–90 min; Q1–Q2 easy, Q3–Q4 medium and worth more; camera and screen share required. The 2025 HackerRank version had ~5 MCQs + 2–3 coding (sometimes SQL), up to 120 min.
companies.focus_zh: 标准 GCA 结构：前两题是简单的数组、字符串模拟，后两题考矩阵操作、网格 BFS、滑动窗口和哈希预处理，DP 很少见。
companies.focus_en: Standard GCA layout: Q1-Q2 are easy array and string simulations, Q3-Q4 bring matrix manipulation, grid BFS, sliding windows and hash-map preprocessing. DP is rare.
companies.style_zh: 题目出自 CodeSignal 题库，重复率高，题面偏长。后两题见过多源 BFS 配双指针、先建字典再离线回答查询，偶尔有字典树。
companies.style_en: Problems come from CodeSignal's bank, so repeats are common, and statements run long. Q3-Q4 have included multi-source BFS combined with two pointers, building a dictionary and answering queries offline, and the occasional trie.
companies.tips_zh: 前两题合计压到 15 分钟左右，把时间留给分值高的后两题。重点练矩阵变换、网格 BFS 和“先预处理、再回答查询”的哈希题。
companies.tips_en: Keep Q1-Q2 to about 15 minutes combined so the higher-scoring Q3-Q4 get the time. Focus on matrix transforms, grid BFS and hash problems where you preprocess once and then answer queries.

companies.name: Uber
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生常见 CodeSignal GCA 式 4 题 70 分钟（2 简单 + 1 中等 + 1 困难），全程监考。少数报告为 60 分钟，或定制的 2 道 medium。多数人做不完 4 题，建议先拿稳前 3 题。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new-grad OA is usually a CodeSignal GCA-style test: 4 problems in 70 min (2 easy, 1 medium, 1 hard), proctored. A few reports mention 60 min or a custom 2-medium version. Most candidates do not finish all 4, so secure the first 3.

refs.title: 1point3acres: Uber 2025 new grad OA, 4 questions on CodeSignal

companies.focus_zh: 偏实现和计数：字符串处理、哈希计数、数组模拟占大头，最后一题常是带更新操作的模拟，中间可能夹一道堆加贪心的调度题。
companies.focus_en: Implementation and counting: string processing, hash counting and array simulation dominate. The last problem is often a simulation with updates, and a heap-plus-greedy scheduling problem may show up in between.
companies.style_zh: 4 题从送分到 medium-hard 递进。2025 年 6 月的一套是：送分题、数字频率统计、任务调度变体，最后一题一边更新数组一边统计和为目标值的下标对。新毕业生题常套无人机送货、图书馆借书之类的故事。
companies.style_en: Four problems ramp from a freebie to medium-hard. A June 2025 set: the freebie, digit frequency counting, a task-scheduler variant, and an array that gets updated while you count index pairs summing to a target. New-grad problems often come with stories like drone delivery or library checkouts.
companies.tips_zh: 速度是关键，据说团队大多看 800+/850。最后一题练“值 → 出现次数”的哈希表随单点更新同步维护，别每次重算；堆调度题要能直接写出来。
companies.tips_en: Speed decides it; teams reportedly look for roughly 800+/850. For the last problem, practice keeping a value -> count hash map in sync with point updates instead of recounting, and be able to write heap-based scheduling from memory.

companies.name: Capital One
companies.sections_zh: 编程前有一段岗位匹配/情境判断选择题（不录像）
companies.sections_en: A role-fit / situational-judgment MCQ exercise before coding (not video-recorded)
companies.notes_zh: 适用 TDP（新毕业生）和技术实习，即 CodeSignal GCA（200–600 分），视频监考；符合条件时可复用已有的 GCA 成绩。通过后进入 Power Day（技术 + case + 行为面）。
companies.notes_en: For TDP (new grad) and technology internships: the CodeSignal GCA (200–600 score), video-proctored; an eligible existing GCA result can be reused. Next step is Power Day (technical + case + behavioral).
companies.focus_zh: 按固定难度阶梯出题：前两题是计数和简单实现，第 3 题是模拟或数据结构题，第 4 题偏难；几乎每套都有一道二维矩阵题。
companies.focus_en: A fixed difficulty ladder: Q1-Q2 are counting and simple implementation, Q3 is a simulation or data-structure task, Q4 is harder. Almost every set has a 2D matrix problem.
companies.style_zh: Q1-Q2 像数字计数、最长连续相同字符、最晚出发时间；Q3 像拆楼后剩下的线段、三消棋盘下落、带更新的数对求和查询；Q4 有交替高度的最少修改、网格最优路径、单调栈求直方图。
companies.style_en: Q1-Q2 look like digit counts, the longest run of one character, or the latest departure time. Q3 is things like segments left after demolitions, match-3 gravity on a grid, or pair-sum queries with updates. Q4 covers alternating heights with minimum edits, the best path through a grid, or a monotonic-stack histogram.
companies.tips_zh: 前两题各给 8 分钟左右，第 3 题 15–20 分钟，剩下全给第 4 题；第 4 题分值最高且有部分分，写不完也要交。矩阵模拟（旋转、重力下落、邻居平均）要专门练。
companies.tips_en: Budget about 8 minutes each for Q1-Q2, 15-20 for Q3, and the rest for Q4. Q4 carries the most points and gives partial credit, so always submit something. Practice matrix simulations specifically: rotation, gravity, neighbor averages.

companies.name: DoorDash
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 新毕业生 OA 多为 HackerRank 两道 LeetCode medium~hard，时长 70–90 分钟（这里取 90），也有用 CodeSignal 的报告。题目常带配送/调度背景：区间、堆、图（多源 BFS）、滑动窗口。
companies.notes_en: New-grad OA is typically 2 HackerRank problems (LeetCode medium to hard) in 70–90 min (90 used here); some report CodeSignal. Problems often have a delivery/dispatch theme: intervals, heaps, graphs (multi-source BFS), sliding window.

refs.title: Glassdoor: DoorDash SWE new grad interviews

companies.focus_zh: 两道 medium~hard，偏配送调度场景：区间扫描、堆、最短路或网格 BFS，以及滑动窗口。
companies.focus_en: Two medium-to-hard problems with a delivery and dispatch flavor: interval sweeps, heaps, shortest paths or grid BFS, and sliding windows.
companies.style_zh: 题目常带外卖、拼车、ETA 背景，比如拼车容量、会议室式的区间重叠、按距离派单；早年报告还有实现表达式计算器。候选人要签保密协议，近年流出的具体题目很少。
companies.style_en: Problems usually come with a food-delivery, carpooling or ETA backdrop: car-pool capacity, meeting-room style interval overlap, dispatching by distance. Older reports mention implementing an expression calculator. Candidates sign NDAs, so few recent problems have leaked.
companies.tips_zh: 重点练区间扫描与合并、堆求 Top-K、Dijkstra 和网格 BFS。代码写得模块化一点，方便应付追加的需求。
companies.tips_en: Drill interval sweep and merge, heap top-K, Dijkstra and grid BFS. Keep the code modular, since follow-up extensions are common.

companies.name: LinkedIn
companies.sections_zh: 部分批次附 CS 基础选择题（DBMS / OS / 网络）
companies.sections_en: Some batches add CS-fundamentals MCQs (DBMS / OS / networking)
companies.notes_zh: 领英没有统一的 OA，平台和题量随岗位、地区变化。实习报告较多的是 HackerRank 3 题 90 分钟（1 easy + 2 medium），也有 2 题或 2–4 题的说法。常考字符串、哈希、二分、树。
companies.notes_en: No single LinkedIn OA; platform and count vary by role and region. Intern reports most often show 3 HackerRank problems in 90 min (1 easy + 2 medium); others report 2 or 2–4. Common: strings, hashing, binary search, trees.

refs.title: LeetCode Discuss: LinkedIn SWE intern OA (3 questions, 90 min)

companies.focus_zh: 字符串和哈希打底，常见二分答案配贪心判断可行性，也会出树上路径和、记忆化搜索、异或技巧这类带点竞赛味的题。
companies.focus_en: Strings and hashing at the base, often binary search on the answer with a greedy feasibility check, plus some competitive-programming-flavored problems: tree path sums, memoized search, XOR tricks.
companies.style_zh: 多为 easy/medium，偶尔一道 hard。报告过“最小化最大漏洞值”（二分答案）、用父节点数组建树后 DFS 求最大向下路径和、异或计数。详细报告多来自印度校招，北美的资料较少。
companies.style_en: Mostly easy/medium, sometimes one hard. Reported problems include minimizing the maximum vulnerability (binary search on the answer), building a tree from a parent array and running DFS for the max downward path sum, and XOR-based counting. Most detailed reports come from India campus hiring; North American data is thinner.
companies.tips_zh: 练“二分答案 + O(n) 贪心检查”，以及从父节点数组建树再做 DFS。异或和位运算技巧在这里出现得比别家多，值得复习一遍。
companies.tips_en: Practice binary search on the answer with an O(n) greedy check, and building trees from parent arrays for DFS. XOR and bit tricks show up here more than at most companies, so review them.

companies.name: Apple
companies.sections_zh: 部分团队附基础选择题
companies.notes_zh: 通用格式（未找到该公司近期报告）：Apple 没有统一 OA，多数团队直接电面，少数团队发 HackerRank（1–2 道编程，有时附选择题）。这里按 HackerRank 两题 90 分钟模拟。
companies.notes_en: Generic format (no recent company-specific reports found): Apple has no standard OA; most teams go straight to phone screens and a few send HackerRank (1–2 coding problems, sometimes MCQs). Simulated as 2 HackerRank problems in 90 min.

refs.title: Glassdoor: Apple interview report (HackerRank first round)

companies.focus_zh: 资料很少：多数团队不发 OA，发的话一般是 medium 难度的字符串和计数题。
companies.focus_en: Little data: most teams skip the OA, and when one is sent it's usually medium string and counting problems.
companies.style_zh: 最清楚的一份是 2025 年印度校招：HackerRank 两题，一道求带指定前后缀的最长子串，一道统计乘积等于 k 的三元组，O(n log n) 就能过，另附几道 CS 基础选择题。
companies.style_en: The clearest report is a 2025 India campus test on HackerRank: the longest substring with a given prefix and suffix, and counting triples whose product equals k. O(n log n) passed. A few CS-fundamentals MCQs came with it.
companies.tips_zh: 收到 HackerRank 链接就按 medium 的字符串和哈希计数准备，顺带复习 OS、内存、网络基础；没收到的话，把精力放在团队的现场编程面。
companies.tips_en: If a HackerRank link arrives, prepare medium string and hash-counting problems and brush up on OS, memory and networking basics. If not, put your effort into the team's live coding rounds.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 报告少且说法不一：多为一道分阶段实现题（先写基础版，再按新需求扩展），常见 90 分钟，不少人卡在第二部分。本模拟用 medium → hard 两题近似。题目偏工程：限流器、LRU、区间合并、流式统计。
companies.notes_en: Few and inconsistent reports: usually one multi-part implementation task (base version, then an extension), commonly 90 min; many fail to finish part 2. Simulated as medium → hard. Engineering-flavored topics: rate limiter, LRU, interval merging, streaming stats.

refs.title: Aced: OpenAI SWE new grad interview guide

companies.focus_zh: 偏工程实现：一道多阶段题不断加需求（内存存储、限流器、流式统计、Top-K），能不能把所有阶段做完基本决定结果。
companies.focus_en: Engineering-style implementation: one multi-part problem that keeps adding requirements (in-memory store, rate limiter, streaming stats, top-k). Finishing every part is largely what separates pass from fail.
companies.style_zh: 报告少且说法不一：有的是一道最多 8 个阶段的递进题，有的是 2 小时两道很难的题。题目像真实代码而不是课本题，通常要维护状态、按时间顺序处理事件，偶尔有网格搜索。
companies.style_en: Reports are few and inconsistent: some describe one problem with up to ~8 stages, others two very hard problems in 2 hours. The problems read like real code rather than textbook puzzles, usually involving state and time-ordered events, occasionally a grid search.
companies.tips_zh: 练快速写出并扩展小型有状态类：带 TTL 的 KV、令牌桶限流、双堆求中位数。用 Python 的话，heapq、collections、bisect 要熟到不用查文档，边写边加几行自测。
companies.tips_en: Practice writing and extending small stateful classes fast: a KV store with TTL, a token-bucket limiter, a two-heap running median. In Python, know heapq, collections and bisect without looking anything up, and add a few self-tests as you go.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: CodeSignal Industry Coding Assessment：一道项目题分 4 关递进（如内存数据库：增删查 → 过滤 → TTL → 历史查询，或银行系统），过关才解锁下一关，本模拟用 4 道独立题近似。2026 有报告增至 6 关；明确禁止使用 AI。
companies.notes_en: CodeSignal Industry Coding Assessment: one project problem in 4 gated levels (e.g. in-memory DB: CRUD → filtering → TTL → historical queries, or a bank system); simulated as 4 independent problems. Some 2026 reports mention 6 levels; AI use is prohibited.
companies.focus_zh: 一道 4 关递进的系统实现题，最常见的是银行系统。几乎不考算法，考的是在描述绕的需求下快速写对，并能随时重构。
companies.focus_en: One system built up over 4 levels, most often a banking system. There's almost no algorithm; the test is getting messy specs right quickly and refactoring as you go.
companies.style_zh: 银行题的典型路线：开户、存款、转账 → 按金额排名 → 带时间戳的定时付款 → 账户合并和历史查询；也有内存数据库的版本。暴力实现完全可以。2026 有报告说增到了 6 关，全程禁用 AI。
companies.style_en: A typical banking run: accounts, deposits and transfers -> rankings by amount -> scheduled payments with timestamps -> account merges and history queries. An in-memory database variant also circulates. Brute force is fine. A 2026 report says it grew to 6 levels, and AI is banned throughout.
companies.tips_zh: 前几分钟把数据模型想清楚（账户对象 + 按时间排序的事件日志），之后就求快。别给定时付款上优先队列之类的优化，做完比做优重要；第 3、4 关的描述多读两遍，Python 最稳。
companies.tips_en: Spend the first few minutes on the data model (account objects plus a time-ordered event log), then go fast. Skip optimizations like a priority queue for scheduled payments; finishing beats efficiency. Read the level 3 and 4 specs twice. Python is the safest choice.

companies.name: Coinbase
companies.sections_zh: 另有逻辑推理（aptitude）测评 + 工作风格问卷
companies.sections_en: Separate aptitude (logical reasoning) test + workstyle questionnaire
companies.notes_zh: 2026 年实习和新毕业生报告多为 CodeSignal 4 题 70 分钟（一份新毕业生报告每题 300 分，满分 1200）；也有人遇到 90 分钟、4 关递进的 Industry Coding 版。邀请一般 2–7 天内完成，是否监考以邀请邮件为准。
companies.notes_en: 2026 intern/new-grad reports mostly show 4 CodeSignal problems in 70 min (one new-grad report: 300 pts each, 1200 total); some got the 90-min 4-level Industry Coding version. Invites usually allow 2–7 days; proctoring per the invite.
companies.focus_zh: 以带金融味的递进实现题为主（账本、手续费、过期、对账），也有人拿到 4 道 easy-medium 的 GCA 式独立题。
companies.focus_en: Mostly a fintech-flavored progressive implementation task (ledger, fees, expiry, reconciliation), though some candidates get four independent easy-medium GCA-style problems instead.
companies.style_zh: 递进版通常是内存银行或账本系统，逐关加入带时间戳的命令、手续费、TTL 过期，以及乱序日志的对账。同时还要做一套逻辑推理测评和工作风格问卷。
companies.style_en: The progressive version is usually an in-memory bank or ledger that adds timestamped commands, fees, TTL expiry and reconciliation of out-of-order logs level by level. An aptitude test and a workstyle survey come bundled with it.
companies.tips_zh: 先把四关的概要都读完，按方便扩展的思路设计（账户表 + 交易历史）；乱序时间戳和非法操作要显式处理。变量名起清楚，评审是直接读你的代码的。
companies.tips_en: Read all four level summaries first and design for extension (account map plus transaction history). Handle out-of-order timestamps and invalid operations explicitly. Use clear names, because reviewers read your code without you there to explain it.

companies.name: Snap
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 近期报告不多：2024 年实习报告为 HackerRank，题目偏简单（链表加法、矩阵行列匹配），2022 年曾用 CodeSignal；校招 Snap Up 首轮是 1 小时的 HackerRank CodePair 视频面。这里按 HackerRank 两题 70 分钟模拟。
companies.notes_en: Sparse recent data: 2024 intern reports show HackerRank with fairly easy problems (linked-list addition, matrix row/column matching); CodeSignal was used in 2022. Snap Up's first round is a 1-hour HackerRank CodePair video interview. Simulated as 2 HackerRank problems in 70 min.

refs.title: Glassdoor: Snap SWE new grad interviews

companies.focus_zh: 资料很少，OA 整体偏简单：链表、矩阵行列匹配这类基础题，加上会追加需求的小型类设计。
companies.focus_en: Little data, and the OA is reportedly on the easy side: basics like linked lists and matrix row/column matching, plus small class designs with follow-up requirements.
companies.style_zh: 报告过链表表示的两数相加、矩阵里相同行与列的匹配，以及 OOP 扩展题（井字棋类、只保留最近 N 条消息并处理乱序序号的存储）。2025 年实习面试偏图论，比如课程表拓扑排序和 DFS 回溯。
companies.style_en: Reported problems: adding two numbers stored as linked lists, matching identical rows and columns in a matrix, and OOP extensions (a tic-tac-toe class, a store that keeps only the last N messages and handles out-of-order sequence numbers). 2025 intern rounds leaned on graphs, such as Course Schedule topological sort and DFS backtracking.
companies.tips_zh: 练会不断追加需求的类设计（有界缓冲、按序号排序），再补拓扑排序和 DFS/回溯。
companies.tips_en: Practice class designs that grow with follow-ups (bounded buffers, ordering by sequence number), then cover topological sort and DFS/backtracking.

companies.name: Pinterest
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 官方流程写明实习和新毕业生先做 CodeSignal 技能测评。2025 年 12 月的实习报告为 GCA 4 题 70 分钟，偏数组题；之后是招聘官电话和 CoderPad 技术面。
companies.notes_en: Pinterest's official intern/new-grad process starts with a CodeSignal skills assessment; a Dec 2025 intern report: GCA, 4 problems in 70 min, array-heavy. Then a recruiter call and a CoderPad technical screen.

refs.title: Pinterest careers: SWE intern & new grad interview process (official)

companies.focus_zh: 标准 GCA 的基础到中等题，以数组、哈希和字符串为主。
companies.focus_en: Standard GCA basics through medium, mostly arrays, hashing and strings.
companies.style_zh: 近期报告偏数组题，有一道对复杂度有要求的哈希题，还有一道找重复出现的子串模式；公开的 SWE 具体题目很少。ML 实习版换成选择题、一道 medium 和两道手写 ML 算法（kNN、k-means、bagging）。
companies.style_en: Recent reports lean toward arrays, including a hashing problem where complexity mattered and one about finding a recurring substring pattern; few specific SWE problems are public. The ML-intern version swaps in MCQs, one medium, and two from-scratch ML tasks (kNN, k-means, bagging).
companies.tips_zh: 按 GCA 常规准备，前三题务必把隐藏用例全部拿下。ML 岗要练不借助 NumPy 手写经典算法。
companies.tips_en: Prepare standard GCA fundamentals and make sure Q1-Q3 pass every hidden test. ML candidates should practice writing classic algorithms in plain Python without NumPy.

companies.name: Airbnb
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 近期报告很少：2022 年为 HackerRank 两题，难度 medium~hard；2025 年不少实习和新毕业生直接进入两轮 45 分钟 CoderPad 技术面。这里按 HackerRank 两题 90 分钟模拟，时长是估计值。
companies.notes_en: Few recent reports: 2022 OA was 2 HackerRank problems (medium to hard); in 2025 many interns/new grads went straight to two 45-min CoderPad rounds. Simulated as 2 HackerRank problems in 90 min (duration estimated).

refs.title: What is the Airbnb online assessment like (DesignGurus)

companies.focus_zh: 资料偏旧，题目实现量大：字符串解析、排序加二分、图搜索和拓扑排序，难度 medium~hard。
companies.focus_en: Older data; implementation-heavy problems covering string parsing, sorting plus binary search, graph search and topological sort, medium to hard.
companies.style_zh: 题目像真实业务代码，比如房源列表分页、文本解析，边界情况多。近几年不少实习和新毕业生直接跳过 OA，进 CoderPad 面试。
companies.style_en: Problems feel like real product code, such as paginating host listings or parsing text, with many edge cases. In recent cycles many interns and new grads skipped the OA and went straight to CoderPad interviews.
companies.tips_zh: 多练边界复杂的实现题（分页、解析），配合 BFS/DFS 和拓扑排序。Airbnb 看重能跑通的干净代码，提交前一定自测。
companies.tips_en: Practice implementation problems with tricky edge cases (pagination, parsing) alongside BFS/DFS and topological sort. Airbnb values clean, working code, so test before you submit.

companies.name: Waymo
companies.sections_zh: 有经验岗的 Byteboard 另有 40 分钟技术推理题
companies.sections_en: Byteboard (experienced roles) adds a 40-min technical reasoning exercise
companies.notes_zh: 通用格式（未找到该公司近期报告）：实习和新毕业生多数直接电面（两道算法题，C++/Python）；有经验岗报告为 Byteboard（技术推理 40 分钟 + 代码实现 70 分钟）。这里按两题 70 分钟模拟。
companies.notes_en: Generic format (no recent company-specific OA reports found): interns/new grads usually go straight to phone screens (2 algorithm problems, C++/Python); experienced roles report Byteboard (40-min reasoning + 70-min implementation). Simulated as 2 problems in 70 min.

refs.title: Interview Query: Waymo software engineer guide

companies.focus_zh: 资料很少。题目看着简单但卡复杂度，多是坐标、传感器数据背景下的数组排序、网格遍历和一维 DP。
companies.focus_en: Very little data. Problems look easy but enforce complexity, framed around coordinates or sensor data: array sorting, grid traversal and 1-D DP.
companies.style_zh: 2025 年 10 月的实习报告：对 XY 坐标排序并过滤损坏数据，能看到正确性反馈，但对时间复杂度有要求。其他资料提到二维矩阵遍历、递归和几何题，2026 有报告说首轮以 DP 为主。
companies.style_en: An Oct 2025 intern report: sort XY locations and filter corrupted readings, with correctness feedback shown but a real time-complexity bar. Other sources mention 2D matrix traversal, recursion and geometry; a 2026 report says the first round centered on DP.
companies.tips_zh: 练带坐标或几何背景的数组排序题、网格 BFS/DFS 和一维 DP；简单题也先算好复杂度再动手。
companies.tips_en: Practice array and sorting problems with coordinate or geometry framing, grid BFS/DFS and 1-D DP. Work out the complexity before coding, even on easy-looking problems.

companies.name: Databricks
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生为 CodeSignal GCA，4 题 70 分钟，须开摄像头并共享屏幕，邀请一周内完成。第 1 题通常很简单，后 3 题 medium~hard，建议 10 分钟内做完前两题。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new grad: CodeSignal GCA, 4 problems in 70 min, camera and screen share required, 1 week to start. Q1 is usually easy, the rest medium to hard; aim to finish the first two within ~10 min.
companies.focus_zh: 以实现为主：按命令列表做模拟、文本排版、哈希计数和区间覆盖，偶尔有 DP 或树。
companies.focus_en: Implementation first: simulating a list of commands, text formatting, hash counting and interval coverage, with the occasional DP or tree problem.
companies.style_zh: 典型题有根据命令序列模拟文本编辑器、统计命令次数、按规则排版聊天消息、计算多段区间的覆盖情况，输出格式要求很死。
companies.style_en: Typical problems: simulate a text editor from a command sequence, count commands, format chat messages under fixed rules, compute coverage over a set of segments. Output formats are strict.
companies.tips_zh: 多练输出规则严格的命令模拟和排版题（折行、对齐），区间覆盖用排序或差分数组解决。代码结构写清楚，后面几轮也不是纯 LeetCode。
companies.tips_en: Get fast at command simulations and formatting with exact output rules (wrapping, alignment), and solve segment coverage with sorting or a difference array. Keep the code well structured; later rounds aren't pure LeetCode either.

companies.name: Bloomberg
companies.sections_zh: 部分入门岗另有 Plum 性格 / 图形推理测评（约 25 分钟）
companies.sections_en: Some entry-level roles add a Plum personality / pattern-reasoning assessment (~25 min)
companies.notes_zh: 北美实习和新毕业生多数直接进 HackerRank CodePair 电面；发 OA 时常见 HackerRank 2–3 题、60–90 分钟（这里取两题 60 分钟）。常考字符串、哈希、区间、堆、图，面试很看重讲清思路。
companies.notes_en: Most NA interns/new grads go straight to a HackerRank CodePair phone screen; when an OA is sent it is usually 2–3 HackerRank problems in 60–90 min (2 in 60 here). Common: strings, hashing, intervals, heaps, graphs; explaining your approach matters.
companies.focus_zh: 以 LeetCode medium 为主：哈希计数、字符串、堆，外加 LRU 这类设计题和树的路径和。
companies.focus_en: Mostly LeetCode medium: hash counting, strings and heaps, plus design problems like LRU and tree path sums.
companies.style_zh: 多数人首轮是工程师陪着做的 60 分钟 HackerRank 直播面：一道主题加追问，比如字符串编解码、频次统计、树的最大路径和、LRU，偶尔一道 hard。真发 OA 的话是 60–90 分钟 2–3 题。
companies.style_en: For most people the first round is a live 60-minute HackerRank session with an engineer: one main problem plus follow-ups, such as string encode/decode, frequency counting, max path sum in a tree or LRU, occasionally a hard. When an automated OA is sent, it's 2-3 problems in 60-90 minutes.
companies.tips_zh: 练边写边把思路和复杂度讲出来，再练接一个变形追问。哈希和堆的 medium、LRU 和点击计数器这类设计题、树的路径和都要覆盖到。
companies.tips_en: Practice explaining your approach and complexity out loud while coding, then handling a twist follow-up. Cover hash-map and heap mediums, design problems like LRU and a hit counter, and tree path sums.

companies.name: Snowflake
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生 OA 为 HackerRank 3 题，难度明显高于一般 OA（以 DP、回溯为主，最后一题常卡 TLE）。时长报告在 60–120 分钟之间，较新的报告为 90 分钟；部分批次只允许 Java/C++。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new-grad OA: 3 HackerRank problems, noticeably harder than average (DP/backtracking heavy; the last one often TLEs). Reported durations range 60–120 min, recent ones 90 min; some batches allow only Java/C++.
companies.focus_zh: 难度明显高于一般 OA，以 DP 为主（字符串上的计数 DP 最常见），另有带约束的调度和位运算计数，最后一题常卡 TLE。
companies.focus_en: Clearly harder than a typical OA and DP-heavy (counting DP over strings is the most common), plus constrained scheduling and bit counting. The last problem often TLEs.
companies.style_zh: 几类题反复出现：字符串模式的计数 DP、带约束的任务调度（排序 + 优先队列）、二进制串并集或同位对计数。2024–2025 年有报告三道全是 hard 级的 DP/回溯。
companies.style_en: The same themes recur across cycles: counting DP over string patterns, task scheduling under constraints (sort plus priority queue), and bit-string union or same-bit pair counting. Some 2024-2025 reports had all three as hard DP/backtracking problems.
companies.tips_zh: 练取模 1e9+7 的计数 DP、以字符串状态为维度的 DP，以及带约束的堆调度。题目复用率高，把候选人整理过的 Snowflake HackerRank 题集刷一遍。
companies.tips_en: Practice counting DP with mod 1e9+7, DP over string states, and heap-based scheduling with constraints. Problems get reused, so work through the Snowflake HackerRank sets candidates have posted.

companies.name: IBM
companies.sections_zh: 部分岗位第二题是在 Web 项目里修 bug（HackerRank 全栈题）
companies.sections_en: For some roles the second task is fixing bugs in a web project (HackerRank full-stack task)
companies.notes_zh: 入门级软件工程师投递后几分钟内就可能收到 HackerRank 测评，常见两题 60 分钟（也有 45、80、90 分钟的报告），须全屏、禁用多显示器；尽量用岗位要求的语言作答。
companies.notes_en: Entry-level SWE applicants may get the HackerRank invite minutes after applying: usually 2 problems in 60 min (45/80/90 also reported), full-screen, no extra monitors; answer in the language the posting asks for.

refs.title: IBM SWE HackerRank with two timed coding questions (PracHub)

companies.focus_zh: easy~medium 的哈希、字符串、贪心和数组题，常见多次查询，要靠排序 + 前缀和 + 二分避免超时。
companies.focus_en: Easy-to-medium hashing, strings, greedy and arrays, often with many queries where sorting plus prefix sums plus binary search avoids a timeout.
companies.style_zh: 通常两题，第二题有时是第一题的扩展。报告过字符串处理、列表/集合求交、滑动窗口，以及“对每个查询 X，求把所有价格改成 X 的最少改动量”。部分岗位换成 1 道 SQL + 1 道 Python，或者选择题。
companies.style_en: Usually two problems, the second sometimes extending the first. Reports mention string manipulation, list/set intersections, sliding windows, and 'for each query X, the minimum unit changes to make every price X'. Some roles get one SQL plus one Python question, or MCQs instead.
companies.tips_zh: 练“排序数组 + 前缀和”回答大量查询，避免 O(n·q)；顺手复习 JOIN、GROUP BY 等基础 SQL。计时不能暂停，留出完整的时间再开始。
companies.tips_en: Practice answering many queries over a sorted array with prefix sums so you avoid O(n*q), and refresh basic SQL (JOIN, GROUP BY). The timer can't be paused, so start only when you have the full block free.

companies.name: Salesforce
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: Futureforce 实习和新毕业生 OA：HackerRank 2–3 道 LeetCode 题，60 分钟硬性时限，AI Proctor 监控切屏和粘贴，须开摄像头；2025 批次的 OA 集中在 5 月底发出。
companies.notes_en: Futureforce intern/new-grad OA: 2–3 HackerRank LeetCode-style problems with a hard 60-min limit; AI Proctor watches tab switches and pasting, camera on. In 2025 most OAs went out in late May.

refs.title: Glassdoor: Salesforce OA report (3 questions, 60 min)

companies.focus_zh: LeetCode 式的 medium 到 medium-hard：贪心、滑动窗口、区间合并、堆和 DP，最后一题明显更难，往往决定结果。
companies.focus_en: LeetCode-style medium to medium-hard: greedy, sliding windows, interval merging, heaps and DP. The last problem is noticeably harder and often decides the outcome.
companies.style_zh: 题面是标准刷题风格，没什么包装。报告提到滑动窗口、贪心合并区间、优先队列、BFS（腐烂的橘子这类）和各种 DP，全程开摄像头、全屏监考。
companies.style_en: Standard LeetCode-style statements without much dressing. Reports mention sliding windows, greedy interval merging, priority queues, BFS (Rotting Oranges style) and various DP, under webcam and full-screen proctoring.
companies.tips_zh: 把区间、堆、BFS、DP 的 medium 练到前两题能很快写完，时间留给最后一题。后面几轮会考 LRU/LFU 和低层设计，可以一起准备。
companies.tips_en: Drill interval, heap, BFS and DP mediums until the first two problems go fast, leaving time for the last one. Later rounds add LRU/LFU and low-level design, so prepare those too.

companies.name: JPMorgan Chase
companies.sections_zh: 之后有 HireVue 录像行为题；部分人以 Code for Good 黑客松代替 Superday
companies.sections_en: Followed by a HireVue recorded behavioral; some candidates get Code for Good instead of a Superday
companies.notes_zh: Software Engineer Program（实习和全职）常见 HackerRank 两题 60 分钟，邀请约 3 天内有效。多为数组、字符串、哈希、栈，偶有 medium-hard。
companies.notes_en: Software Engineer Program (intern and full-time): usually 2 HackerRank problems in 60 min, invite valid ~3 days. Mostly arrays, strings, hash maps, stacks; occasionally medium-hard.
companies.focus_zh: easy~medium 的前缀和与区间、哈希计数、栈和贪心，偶尔有多步骤的解析题。
companies.focus_en: Easy-to-medium prefix sums and intervals, hash counting, stacks and greedy, with the occasional multi-step parsing task.
companies.style_zh: 常见的有异位词分组、区间合并、窗口计数、括号和栈类题，题面不长。之后一般跟一轮 HireVue 录像行为面，部分地区另有能力测评。
companies.style_en: Common problems: grouping anagrams, merging intervals, window counts, bracket and stack problems, with fairly short statements. A HireVue recorded behavioral usually follows, and some regions add an aptitude section.
companies.tips_zh: 隐藏用例决定结果：先让正确的暴力解跑通再优化，重复元素、空输入、最大规模都要测。异位词分组、区间合并和窗口计数多练几道。
companies.tips_en: Hidden tests decide it: get a correct brute force passing first, then optimize, and test duplicates, empty input and max constraints. Do a few extra anagram-grouping, interval-merging and window-count problems.

companies.name: Cisco
companies.sections_zh: 网络、操作系统、数据库等 CS 基础选择题
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生 OA 多为 HackerRank：2–3 道 LeetCode easy~medium（常是经典题改编）加一组 CS 基础选择题，整卷 70–90 分钟；这里只模拟两道编程、60 分钟。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new-grad OA is usually HackerRank: 2–3 LeetCode easy-medium problems (often twists on classics) plus CS-fundamentals MCQs, 70–90 min total; only 2 coding problems in 60 min are simulated here.
companies.focus_zh: easy~medium 的数组、字符串和哈希题，多是经典题改编，偶尔有链表、位运算和基础 DP。
companies.focus_en: Easy-to-medium arrays, strings and hashing, mostly twists on classics, with the occasional linked list, bit manipulation or basic DP.
companies.style_zh: 报告过标准的图遍历题和 Expressive Words 这类字符串题。常附一组网络、操作系统选择题，格式随团队变化较大。
companies.style_en: Reports mention a standard graph traversal and string problems like Expressive Words. A set of networking and OS MCQs is often attached, and the format varies a lot by team.
companies.tips_zh: 字符串解析和 easy-medium 的 BFS/DFS 要熟练；顺带复习子网划分、TCP/IP、ping 这些网络基础。嵌入式岗多看位运算。
companies.tips_en: Get comfortable with string parsing and easy-medium BFS/DFS. Review networking basics (subnetting, TCP/IP, ping) for the MCQs; embedded roles lean on bit operations.

companies.name: Goldman Sachs
companies.sections_zh: Software Diagnostics（45 分钟，在 Django / Node.js / Spring Boot 项目里调试修 bug）；Strats 岗另有 22 分钟数学
companies.sections_en: Software Diagnostics (45 min, debug an existing Django / Node.js / Spring Boot repo); Strats add a 22-min Math challenge
companies.notes_zh: 官方现行格式按岗位分段：所有人做 30 分钟 Software Fundamentals（数据结构与算法，题数未公布，报告多为 2 题），工程岗再加 Software Diagnostics。旧帖里的“两题 120 分钟 + 数学”已经过时。
companies.notes_en: Current official format is role-based: everyone takes a 30-min Software Fundamentals challenge (DSA; count unpublished, reports say 2), engineering adds Software Diagnostics. The old '2 problems in 120 min + math' posts are outdated.

refs.title: Goldman Sachs: Your guide to HackerRank success (official)

companies.focus_zh: 30 分钟的基础编程段考 easy~medium 的哈希、字符串、数学和模拟题，偶尔有股票买卖、LIS 这类经典 DP；工程岗另有一段在现成项目里修 bug。
companies.focus_en: The 30-minute fundamentals section covers easy-to-medium hashing, strings, math and simulation, sometimes classic DP like stock trading or LIS. Engineering roles add a section fixing bugs in an existing app.
companies.style_zh: 2025 年报告的题有多次交易的股票买卖、最长递增子序列，以及数组、字符串、哈希题。Software Diagnostics 要在陌生的 Django / Node / Spring 项目里定位并修好问题。
companies.style_en: 2025 reports include multi-transaction stock buy/sell and LIS alongside array, string and hashing problems. Software Diagnostics has you locate and fix bugs in an unfamiliar Django, Node or Spring codebase.
companies.tips_zh: 股票系列和 LIS 这些经典 DP 要能默写，再找个陌生仓库练一两次顺着报错找 bug。只有 30 分钟，简单题争取一次写对。
companies.tips_en: Know the classic DP problems (the stock series, LIS) cold, and practice tracing a bug through an unfamiliar repo once or twice. With only 30 minutes, write the easy problems right the first time.

companies.name: Akuna Capital
companies.sections_zh: 部分批次另有调试 / 补全代码题
companies.sections_en: Some batches add a debugging / code-completion task
companies.notes_zh: 题面长、偏模拟（撮合引擎、股票买卖匹配、LRU），不是典型 LeetCode。2025 年报告约 1 小时 3 题，早年为 90–120 分钟。常用 C++，部分岗位限定语言。
companies.notes_en: Long, simulation-style prompts (matching engine, buy/sell matching, LRU) rather than classic LeetCode. 2025 reports: ~1 hour for 3 problems (90–120 min in earlier years). C++ is common; some roles restrict languages.
companies.focus_zh: 题面长、偏模拟，不是标准 LeetCode：订单撮合、按规则逐条处理的贪心、前缀和与堆，LRU 缓存是常客。
companies.focus_en: Long, simulation-style prompts rather than standard LeetCode: order matching, rule-driven greedy processing, prefix sums and heaps, with LRU cache as a regular.
companies.style_zh: 典型题是限价订单簿、市价单撮合，每条规则都得照做。C++ 方向报告约 80 分钟 3 道算法题，之后还有岗位专属的测评（C++ 调试或更长的优化题）。
companies.style_en: The classic is a limit order book or market-order matching engine where every rule has to be followed exactly. The C++ track reports about 3 algorithm problems in ~80 minutes, then a role-specific assessment (C++ debugging or a longer optimization task).
companies.tips_zh: 自己用堆和有序 map 写一个小型撮合引擎，再从零写一遍 LRU。多练快速读完长题面，把规则一条条落实。
companies.tips_en: Build a small matching engine with heaps and ordered maps, and write an LRU cache from scratch. Practice reading long specs quickly and implementing each rule exactly.

companies.name: Citadel
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: SWE 实习和全职 OA 为 HackerRank 两题：实习 65 分钟，2025–26 全职 75 分钟。题目原创（二分答案、矩阵旋转、几何），难度中等偏上，隐藏用例多，注意边界和复杂度。
companies.notes_en: SWE intern/full-time OA: 2 HackerRank problems, 65 min for interns and 75 min for 2025–26 full-time. Original problems (binary search on answer, matrix rotation, geometry), medium-plus difficulty with many hidden tests.
companies.focus_zh: 两道原创 medium~hard，最常见的是二分答案和前缀和 + 哈希计数，基本要求隐藏用例全过。
companies.focus_en: Two original medium-to-hard problems, most often binary search on the answer and prefix sums with hash counting. You effectively need to pass every hidden test.
companies.style_zh: 2025 年报告：统计首尾相等、中间和满足条件的子数组（前缀和 + 哈希）；每次给一个元素减 x、其余减 y，求清零的最少次数（二分答案）；两台服务器的升级排期（二分）。也出过矩阵旋转和几何。
companies.style_en: 2025 reports: count subarrays with equal endpoints whose interior sum meets a condition (prefix sums + hash map); the minimum operations to zero an array where each step subtracts x from one element and y from the rest (binary search on the answer); scheduling upgrades across two servers (binary search). Matrix rotation and geometry have also appeared.
companies.tips_zh: 把“二分答案 + O(n) 可行性判断”和“前缀和 + 哈希计数”练熟。一律用 64 位整数，确保大数据的隐藏用例能过。
companies.tips_en: Master binary search on the answer with an O(n) feasibility check, and prefix-sum + hash counting. Use 64-bit integers throughout and make sure the large hidden tests pass.

companies.name: MathWorks
companies.sections_zh: 前置 HireVue 视频（Why MathWorks）；部分批次附 MATLAB / 数学选择题
companies.sections_en: HireVue video first (why MathWorks); some batches add MATLAB / math MCQs
companies.notes_zh: EDG（新毕业生）和实习：HackerRank 两道 medium（字符串、滑动窗口、矩阵）。2026 年报告没写时长，早年 45–90 分钟不等，这里取 60 分钟。
companies.notes_en: EDG (new grad) and interns: 2 HackerRank medium problems (strings, sliding window, matrices). 2026 reports omit the duration; earlier ones range 45–90 min, 60 used here.
companies.focus_zh: 两道 medium，贪心和数学（筛法、gcd、欧拉函数）比重高，也有矩阵操作和前缀和、二分，解法慢会挂性能用例。
companies.focus_en: Two mediums, heavy on greedy and math (sieve, gcd, Euler's totient), plus matrix manipulation and prefix sums or binary search. Slow solutions fail the performance tests.
companies.style_zh: 报告过对列表里每个数求欧拉函数（得用筛法）、数组和矩阵的原地变换。早年版本混有数学和 CS 选择题，关于难度各家说法不一。
companies.style_en: Reported problems include computing Euler's totient for every value in a list (needs a sieve) and in-place array and matrix transforms. Older versions mixed in math and CS MCQs; reports disagree on difficulty.
companies.tips_zh: 复习筛法、gcd、欧拉函数这些数论基础和原地矩阵操作，写完按最大数据规模估一下复杂度。可选的 MATLAB 部分据说做了有帮助。
companies.tips_en: Brush up on number theory (sieve, gcd, totient) and in-place matrix operations, and estimate complexity at max input size before submitting. Doing the optional MATLAB section reportedly helps.

companies.name: Visa
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生多为 CodeSignal 4 题 70–75 分钟（2 简单 + 1 中等 + 1 困难），须开摄像头、麦克风并接受屏幕监控；也有 5 题或 HackerRank 3 题的报告。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new grad: usually CodeSignal, 4 problems in 70–75 min (2 easy, 1 medium, 1 hard), camera, mic and screen monitored; 5-problem and HackerRank 3-problem variants are also reported.

refs.title: Taro: Visa SWE new grad experience (Sep 2025)

companies.focus_zh: GCA 式 4 题：两道简单实现、一道 medium、一道 hard，内容是数组和数学逻辑、矩阵模拟、哈希计数和滑动窗口。
companies.focus_en: GCA-style four problems: two easy implementations, one medium and one hard, covering array and math logic, matrix simulation, hash counting and sliding windows.
companies.style_zh: 报告过在二维矩阵里行走（有障碍和传送门）、栈、窗口计数，以及按轮次给商品排名的模拟题。2026 年部分批次改用 HackerRank，出了图和 DP。
companies.style_en: Reported problems include walking a 2D matrix with obstacles and portals, stacks, window counts, and a round-robin product-ranking simulation. Some 2026 cycles used HackerRank with graph and DP problems.
companies.tips_zh: 两道简单题要做得非常快，多数人是倒在第 4 题没时间。按 70 分钟计时多练矩阵行走模拟和窗口计数。
companies.tips_en: Finish the two easy problems very fast; running out of time on Q4 is the usual failure. Practice matrix-walk simulations and window counts under a 70-minute timer.

companies.name: Rubrik
companies.sections_zh: 新毕业生版另有约 10 道多线程 / 并发选择题
companies.sections_en: New-grad version adds ~10 multithreading / concurrency MCQs
companies.notes_zh: 实习报告为 90 分钟 3 道编程；2025 年新毕业生报告则是 60 分钟 1 道字符串 DP 加 10 道并发选择题。后续面试偏并发和系统，OA 难度中等偏上。
companies.notes_en: Intern reports: 3 coding problems in 90 min; a 2025 new-grad report: 60 min with 1 string-DP problem + 10 concurrency MCQs. Later rounds focus on concurrency and systems; OA difficulty is medium-plus.
companies.focus_zh: 难度中等偏上，字符串处理和字符串 DP 最突出，也有贪心、前缀和与栈；新毕业生版还考并发选择题。
companies.focus_en: Medium-plus. String processing and string DP stand out, with greedy, prefix sums and stacks too; the new-grad version adds concurrency MCQs.
companies.style_zh: 实习一般是 90 分钟 3 道编程；2025 年新毕业生报告是 1 道字符串 DP（编辑距离、划分这类）加 10 道多线程选择题。详细的帖子大多在一亩三分地，要登录才能看。
companies.style_en: Interns typically get 3 coding problems in 90 minutes; a 2025 new-grad report had one string DP problem (edit-distance or partition style) plus 10 multithreading MCQs. Most detailed write-ups sit behind a 1point3acres login.
companies.tips_zh: 准备编辑距离、字符串划分这类字符串 DP，再复习锁、竞态、死锁等并发基础，选择题和后面的面试都用得上。
companies.tips_en: Prepare string DP (edit distance, partitioning) and review concurrency basics (locks, races, deadlock), which show up in the MCQs and later rounds.

companies.name: Intuit
companies.sections_zh: SQL 一题 + Bash 一题（与编程共用 90 分钟）
companies.sections_en: One SQL + one Bash task (sharing the 90 minutes with coding)
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生 OA 为 HackerRank 90 分钟：1–2 道编程加 SQL 和 Bash 各一题（早年用 Glider）。本模拟只给编程部分约 60 分钟；有报告说不给部分分。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new-grad OA: 90 min on HackerRank with 1–2 coding problems plus one SQL and one Bash task (Glider in earlier years). Only the coding part (~60 min) is simulated; some report no partial credit.

refs.title: Intuit OA 2026 guide: code, SQL & Bash

companies.focus_zh: 几道 easy~medium 的短题，堆、网格 BFS、栈、前缀和与一维 DP 都会碰到，覆盖面广，单题不深。
companies.focus_en: Several short easy-to-medium problems touching heaps, grid BFS, stacks, prefix sums and 1-D DP: wide coverage, none very deep.
companies.style_zh: 报告过的题有优先队列题、腐烂的橘子（多源 BFS）、两个有序数组在相等值处切换的最大路径和（双指针）、字符串解码（栈）、数据流中位数，大多贴近经典原题。
companies.style_en: Reported problems: a priority-queue task, Rotting Oranges (multi-source BFS), max path sum across two sorted arrays switching at equal values (two pointers), Decode String (stack), median of a data stream. Most stay close to the classic originals.
companies.tips_zh: 双堆求中位数、多源 BFS、用栈解码这几个模板要能默写。整卷还有 SQL 和 Bash 小题，别把时间全压在编程上。
companies.tips_en: Have the two-heap median, multi-source BFS and stack-based decoding ready to write from memory. The full test also has SQL and Bash tasks, so don't spend all the time on coding.

companies.name: Pure Storage
companies.sections_zh: 5–7 道 CS 基础选择题（含读代码找 bug）
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生 OA：HackerRank 约 5–7 道选择题加 2 道 LeetCode easy~medium。整卷 60–75 分钟（未经候选人证实），这里编程按 60 分钟模拟。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new-grad OA: HackerRank with ~5–7 MCQs + 2 LeetCode easy-medium problems; 60–75 min total (not confirmed by candidates); coding simulated as 60 min.

refs.title: Interview Query: Pure Storage interview guide

companies.focus_zh: 2 道 easy~medium，以哈希计数和字符串为主，略带数学味，另有一组考树和并发的 CS 基础选择题。
companies.focus_en: Two easy-to-medium problems, mainly hash counting and strings with some math flavor, plus a set of CS-fundamentals MCQs on trees and concurrency.
companies.style_zh: 编程题不长，偏数组、字符串和计数，偶尔有回文类 DP。2025 年有帖子提到一道二分查找的调试题和几道多线程题。
companies.style_en: Coding problems are short and lean on arrays, strings and counting, occasionally a palindrome DP. A 2025 thread mentions a binary-search debugging task and some multithreading questions.
companies.tips_zh: 据说通过线要求很高，easy-medium 要又快又稳地全过。选择题前复习树的性质和并发概念。
companies.tips_en: The bar reportedly expects a high pass rate, so clear the easy-medium problems quickly and completely. Review tree properties and concurrency concepts for the MCQs.

companies.name: The D. E. Shaw Group
companies.sections_zh: 数学 / 概率和 CS 基础（OS、网络）选择题，可能倒扣分
companies.sections_en: Math / probability and CS-fundamentals (OS, networking) MCQs, possibly with negative marking
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生 OA 为 HackerRank 2–3 道 medium~hard 编程，整卷 90–120 分钟；2025 年不少报告是编程加选择题的混合卷。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new-grad OA: 2–3 HackerRank medium-to-hard coding problems, 90–120 min total; many 2025 reports describe a hybrid with MCQs.

refs.title: Taro: D. E. Shaw SWE internship experience (2025)

companies.focus_zh: medium~hard 的竞赛风格题，以 DP、二分、贪心构造和数学为主，通过率低。
companies.focus_en: Medium-to-hard, Codeforces-flavored problems centered on DP, binary search, greedy/constructive ideas and math. Pass rates are low.
companies.style_zh: 难度大约在 Codeforces 1400–1800，站内收录的真题有三分之二是 hard。校招卷还配有概率、能力倾向和 OS、网络选择题，可能倒扣分；部分实习流程考 SQL。
companies.style_en: Roughly Codeforces 1400-1800 in difficulty, and two-thirds of the real problems we've collected are rated hard. Campus versions add probability, aptitude and OS/networking MCQs, possibly with negative marking; some intern loops include SQL.
companies.tips_zh: 别只刷 LeetCode，限时做 Codeforces Div2 的 B–D 题（贪心构造、DP）。选择题部分提前复习概率和基础 SQL。
companies.tips_en: Don't stop at LeetCode: do timed Codeforces Div2 B-D problems (greedy/constructive, DP). Review probability and basic SQL for the MCQ sections.

companies.name: Roblox
companies.sections_zh: 两项 Roblox 游戏内认知测评（组装赛车过关、优化工厂产线）+ 职场情境判断题
companies.sections_en: Two in-Roblox cognitive games (car assembly obstacle course, factory line optimization) + workplace situational judgment
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生：CodeSignal 定制编程测验约 70 分钟，近两年报告为 2 道题（1 medium + 1 hard，偏实现和模拟），不能复用以往的 CodeSignal 成绩。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new grad: a custom CodeSignal coding test of ~70 min; recent reports show 2 problems (1 medium + 1 hard, implementation/simulation heavy); prior CodeSignal scores cannot be reused.

refs.title: 1point3acres: Roblox OA, previous CodeSignal scores not reusable

companies.focus_zh: 编程部分偏实现和模拟：网格消除下落、机器人指令循环、限流计数、日志解析，外加反复出现的字典树和拓扑排序；另有游戏化测评。
companies.focus_en: The coding section is implementation and simulation: grid match-and-fall, robot command loops, rate limiting and counting, log parsing, plus a recurring trie problem and topological sort. Game-based assessments come alongside.
companies.style_zh: 一般是 1 道 medium + 1 道 hard，常要写 40–80 行不出错的模拟：消除后让格子下落、判断机器人走指令时有没有进入循环、命中计数器、在更新中追踪最大值。一道较难的字典树题和一道中等的拓扑排序被多次提到。
companies.style_en: Usually one medium and one hard, often 40-80 lines of bug-free simulation: clearing matches and letting cells fall, detecting cycles in a robot's command loop, hit counters, tracking the top value under updates. A hard trie problem and a medium topological sort come up repeatedly.
companies.tips_zh: 练快速写出中等长度的模拟代码，重点测窗口边界和大输入。开始前把 Roblox 和 CodeSignal 账号都准备好，游戏测评也要认真做。
companies.tips_en: Practice writing medium-length simulations quickly, and stress-test window boundaries and large inputs. Set up both Roblox and CodeSignal accounts beforehand, and take the games seriously.

companies.name: ZipRecruiter
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 2024 年秋季新毕业生报告为 4 题的 OA，电面也在 CodeSignal 上做分轮递进题；未找到公开的时长，按 GCA 的 70 分钟模拟。
companies.notes_en: Fall 2024 new-grad reports describe a 4-problem OA, and the phone screen is a multi-round progressive task on CodeSignal; no public duration found, so the GCA's 70 min is used.
companies.focus_zh: 以模拟和实现为主：矩阵操作、数组模拟、字符串处理、区间覆盖，近期还出现了 4 关递进的内存 KV 数据库。
companies.focus_en: Simulation and implementation: matrix operations, array simulations, string processing and interval coverage, and recently a 4-level progressive in-memory KV database.
companies.style_zh: 早年实习 OA 是 4 道 easy-medium 的 GCA 式题；新报告是一道 4 关递进题：set/get/delete → 前缀扫描 → TTL → 备份恢复。公开的细节不多。
companies.style_en: Earlier intern OAs were four easy-medium GCA-style problems. A recent report describes one 4-level build: set/get/delete -> prefix scans -> TTL -> backup/restore. Public details are sparse.
companies.tips_zh: 计时 90 分钟，把 4 关 KV 库从头到尾写一遍；再刷几道矩阵和数组模拟，保持手速。
companies.tips_en: Build the 4-level KV store end to end once under a 90-minute timer, then do a few matrix and array simulations to keep your speed up.

companies.name: eBay
companies.sections_zh: 无
companies.notes_zh: 实习和新毕业生多为 CodeSignal 4 题 70 分钟（1 很简单 + 2 中等 + 1 困难，例如聊天消息里的 @ 提及计数）；少数为 HackerRank。
companies.notes_en: Intern/new grad: usually CodeSignal, 4 problems in 70 min (1 very easy, 2 medium, 1 hard, e.g. counting @mentions in chat logs); a few report HackerRank.
companies.focus_zh: 标准 GCA 难度梯度，主要是数组和哈希计数的实现题，加上字符串处理和滑动窗口。
companies.focus_en: A standard GCA difficulty ladder, mostly array and hash-counting implementation, plus string processing and sliding windows.
companies.style_zh: 1 道很简单、2 道中等、1 道难，比如统计聊天记录里的 @ 提及次数。据说分数要过 500 左右才能进下一轮，近期公开报告不多。
companies.style_en: One very easy, two medium and one hard, e.g. counting @mentions in chat logs. Candidates say you need roughly 500+ to advance; recent public reports are few.
companies.tips_zh: 按 CodeSignal 70 分钟做整套计时练习，把数组实现和哈希计数练稳，先保住前三题。
companies.tips_en: Do full 70-minute CodeSignal-style timed sets and get solid on array implementation and hash counting so Q1-Q3 are secure.

companies.name: Oracle
companies.sections_zh: 部分批次有能力倾向、OOP、OS、DBMS 选择题
companies.sections_en: Some batches include aptitude / OOP / OS / DBMS MCQs
companies.notes_zh: Oracle 各团队独立招聘，格式差异大：常见 HackerRank 2–3 道 medium（数组、字符串、树、图、DP），整卷 60–120 分钟；北美 OCI 新毕业生也常直接电面。
companies.notes_en: Oracle hires per team, so formats vary: commonly 2–3 HackerRank medium problems (arrays, strings, trees, graphs, DP), 60–120 min total; NA OCI new grads often go straight to phone screens.
companies.focus_zh: 格式因团队而异，多为 medium 的数组和字符串题（Kadane、零和子数组这类前缀和题），部分批次附带 SQL 或 REST API 题。
companies.focus_en: The format varies by team; mostly medium array and string problems (Kadane, zero-sum subarrays and other prefix-sum work), with SQL or a REST API task in some batches.
companies.style_zh: 报告过最大子数组和、最长和为零子数组、LIS 等经典题。有的卷还有一道 SQL 和一道 REST API 题（从 URL 拉分页 JSON 再做聚合），印度校招另有能力倾向和 DBMS、OS 选择题。
companies.style_en: Reported problems include max subarray sum, longest zero-sum subarray and LIS. Some tests add a SQL query and a REST API task (fetch paginated JSON from a URL and aggregate it); India campus versions add aptitude and DBMS/OS MCQs.
companies.tips_zh: 前缀和 + 哈希类题多练几道；再做两三道 HackerRank 的 REST API 题和简单 SQL，免得考场上第一次见。
companies.tips_en: Do a few extra prefix-sum + hash map problems, and try two or three HackerRank REST API questions plus some easy SQL so they aren't new on test day.
